item_title: Final adoption of Ordinance No. 31328 (East Village BID)
document_text:
Action: Upon motion by Councilmember Bien Doan, seconded by Rosemary Kamei, and carried unanimously, the Consent Calendar was approved as a whole. The actions below were taken as indicated. (11-0-0)

2.2 Final Adoption of Ordinances. (a) Ordinance No. 31328 - An Ordinance of the City of San José Establishing the East Village Business Improvement District Pursuant to the Parking And Business Improvement Area Law of 1989. [Passed for Publication on 6/2/2026 - Item 8.1 (26-662)]

Action: Ordinance No. 31328 was adopted, establishing the East Village Business Improvement District Pursuant to the Parking And Business Improvement Area Law of 1989. (11-0-0)
